data.name: Subtitle
data.value: The complete project state as a ZIP: export it, import it again and keep snapshots to follow what changed.

data.name: TargetHint_Json
data.value: Neutral format for your own pipelines — the files sit right at the root of the archive.

data.name: TargetHint_Unity
data.value: To be unpacked into the Unity project — the content ends up under Assets/StreamingAssets/GameDevManager/.

data.name: TargetHint_Unreal
data.value: To be unpacked into the Unreal project — the content ends up under Content/GameDevManager/.

data.name: TargetHint_Godot
data.value: To be unpacked into the Godot project — the content ends up under res://gamedevmanager/.

data.name: ModulesHint
data.value: Without a selection all modules go out. Deselected ones appear as an empty list in the archive — the structure stays the same so import and diff find their way.

data.name: PerEntityLayoutHint
data.value: For Git: the content sits as “content/items/<guid>.json” instead of one file per module — the diff then shows which entry changed. The import reads both layouts.

data.name: MinimumStatusHint
data.value: Empty means: everything goes out. Otherwise only what has at least this status comes along — mind that an omitted entry may be referenced elsewhere.

data.name: IncludeAssetsHint
data.value: Sprites, sounds and every other uploaded file travel along in the ZIP. Without them the export contains only the metadata of the assets.

data.name: ContentHint
data.value: In addition: types and fields, field values, conditions and a README with notes on the chosen target.

data.name: HealthWarning
data.value: The status check reports {0} open findings. The export is still possible — it contains the state as it is.

data.name: HistoryIntro
data.value: Kept snapshots can be downloaded, imported again and compared with each other — that is how it becomes traceable what a content update changed.

data.name: RemoteOnlyHint
data.value: Local pruning removed these snapshots; their mirror copy lives in the S3 backup target. The way back leads through the bucket — download and import as a ZIP.

data.name: SnapshotDeleteConfirmMessage
data.value: Delete the snapshot from {0} for good?

data.name: PrunedOneMessage
data.value: One old snapshot has been removed.

data.name: PrunedNothingMessage
data.value: There was nothing to clean up.

data.name: RetentionHintCount
data.value: Retention: at most {0} snapshots per project — when a new one is created the oldest fall away. The most recent one always remains.

data.name: RetentionHintAge
data.value: Retention: at most {0} days — older snapshots fall away when a new one is created. The most recent one always remains.

data.name: RetentionHintBoth
data.value: Retention: at most {0} snapshots per project, and none older than {1} days — when a new one is created, anything beyond that falls away. The most recent one always remains.

data.name: RetentionHintOff
data.value: Retention: unlimited — snapshots stay until deleted here by hand. An upper bound or a maximum age can be set via “Exports:MaxPerProject” or “Exports:MaxAgeDays”.

data.name: ImportIntro
data.value: Reads an export ZIP back in — to move a project or restore a backup. All GUIDs are preserved.

data.name: ReplaceExistingHint
data.value: Removes all content of the project before importing — the previous state is kept automatically beforehand. Without this option the import only works into an empty project.

data.name: ImportConfirmMessage
data.value: The import first removes all existing content of this project and replaces it with the state from the ZIP. The previous state is kept as an export snapshot beforehand and can be brought back from there.

data.name: ImportInvalidZip
data.value: The file is not a readable export ZIP.

data.name: DiffIntro
data.value: Puts two snapshots side by side — per module: what was added, what fell away and which properties changed.

data.name: ExportNotAllowed
data.value: Export is not enabled for this account.

data.name: ImportNotAllowed
data.value: Import is not enabled for this account.

data.name: DesignIntro
data.value: The content as a readable document to hand on — a standalone HTML file with embedded images, for publishers or new team members.

data.name: DesignPrintHint
data.value: For a PDF open the file in the browser and print it — the template is print-friendly.

data.name: CsvIntro
data.value: The road spreadsheet ↔ tool for balancing: download a module as a table, maintain it in your spreadsheet program and read it back in. The import matches on the column “id”, otherwise on “name” — whatever is in no row stays untouched. Child collections, conditions and assets cannot travel in a table; the ZIP export remains for those.
